notes.title: Notes about 10th of Dec 2024 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience in these first few days from release, 
a bug that prevented you from enjoying the game surfaced:
-Black screen/AI driving your car when disabling realtime reflections
It is now solved!
Stay tuned, big things will come in the future =)

notes.title: Race error fixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented players to race correctly.
